summary: Wave 6 creator-page work (supporter wall opt-in + live preview + public rendering, default presets 10/25/50/100 with $10 floor, non-custodial note, shop grid rules, mobile sticky buy bar) + Wave 2-3 dashboard regression sweep. ALL Wave 6 acceptance criteria pass. Backend GET /api/pay/creator/devhub returns support_widget with preset_amounts=[10,25,50,100], min_amount=10, show_wall=false, recent_supporters=[] when wall is off. Toggling support_widget_show_wall via PUT /api/user/creator/profile → GET public endpoint correctly returns show_wall=true and 4 recent_supporters (Jon / Alice / Bob / null anonymous) each with amount>0, currency:USD, iso 'at'. Names are all first-name-only, no spaces; anonymous has name=null. Frontend /devhub shows creator-support-widget with presets 10/25/50/100 + Custom, $10 minimum, submit reads 'Buy a $10.00 coffee', non-custodial note text 'Paid straight to The — Dynopay never holds your funds.' (contains 'never holds your funds'), creator-supporter-wall renders with 4 supporter rows when show_wall=true and is ABSENT when off. /storefront (DE UI) exposes data-testid=support-widget-show-wall toggle with label 'Unterstützer-Wand — neueste öffentliche Trinkgelder anzeigen'; enabling it shows data-testid=preview-supporter-wall containing 'Alex $10' and 'Someone $25' rows; Save button ('Änderungen speichern') persists (toast 'Creator page saved'); public /devhub reflects the change; restore-to-OFF verified as final step (FINAL show_wall=False, supporters=0). /devhub/shop with 1 product: shop-search-input ABSENT, shop-toolbar-categories ABSENT (visual 'All/Digital' chips are separate ShopHero UI), shop-grid has 1 item, product title 'Talk to a Developer' fully visible, minicart-fab hidden when empty. Product page mobile 390x844: product-sticky-buy-bar visible with product-sticky-price='$100.00', product-sticky-add-to-cart + product-sticky-buy-now present; add-to-cart flow shows product-detail-added alert, minicart-fab badge 1, minicart-remove empties cart back to hidden fab. Desktop 1920x800: product-sticky-buy-bar exists but display=none (hidden). Wave 2-3 regression (auth): /dashboard dash2026-root, /transactions transactions-range-presets, /payouts (payouts-root/tiles/wallets/recent/range-bar/export-csv-btn all present), /wallet (wallet-security-strip + wallet-security-strip-level; wallet-coverage-strip absent = full coverage, per spec optional), /wallet/security → /settings?section=security with settings-security, /invoices (invoices-period-totals + invoices-tile-collected + tax-period-select + invoices-export-period), /storefront (your-page-header/state/url/funnel/range-7d/30d/90d/edit-btn all present), /customers (customers-stat-* + customers-search-input), /referrals loads (referral-reward-banner absent = no active reward, allowed), /settings?section=language (settings-language-section + en/de), /developer-keys (dev-health-strip), /notifications (notifications-kind-filter). Sidebar 'Auszahlungsadressen' label present (Payout addresses rename intact). Backend: /api/invoices/period-summary?period=thisMonth 200 {collected,fees,tax_collected,receipts_count numbers}, /api/pay/getPaymentLinks 200 rows with stats {paid_30d_count, paid_30d_usd, paid_total_count, last_paid_at}, /api/user/creator/funnel?period=30d 200 {views:7, checkouts:14, paid:0, paid_usd:0}, /api/dashboard/developer-health?company_id=1 200 with webhooks strip. SAFE MODE preserved: no writes other than the user's own support_widget_show_wall flag which is restored to FALSE at end. No refunds, links, addresses, tips, checkouts, language changes.

issues: Copy reads 'Paid straight to The — Dynopay never holds your funds.' The brand name looks truncated ('The' with no continuation before the em dash). Spec allows this, and 'never holds your funds' is present, but a full brand name ('The Dev Store') would read better.

action_items: Consider showing the full brand name in creator-noncustodial-note ('Paid straight to The Dev Store — Dynopay never holds your funds.') instead of the truncated 'The —'.

Payment-links list rows have no [data-testid^='paylink-row'] wrapper testid (0 rows detected via testid selector despite backend returning multiple rows). Detail modal QR block therefore cannot be opened from the list via a robust testid; consider adding paylink-row-<id> data-testid to each row for E2E stability.

React validateDOMNesting console warning:
cannot appear as a descendant of

(originates from an Emotion element on one of the dashboards). Not blocking, but a lint-level fix.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/controller/payment/paymentLinkController.ts creator handler correctly gates recent_supporters on show_wall and returns [] when disabled. First-name-only extraction and anonymous-null handling look correct.

Components/Page/Creator/CreatorPageSettings.tsx: support-widget-show-wall toggle uses a Radix Switch (SPAN) whose data-testid is on the wrapper span (no data-state/aria-checked). A hidden input inside carries checked state; add data-state or aria-checked on the same node for easier automation.

Components/Page/Shop/ShopHero.tsx renders 'All / Digital' category chips visually even for 1-product shops. The spec-gated categories UI (>8 products) uses data-testid=shop-toolbar-categories in ShopToolbar and is correctly hidden; but the visible ShopHero chips are duplicative when the shop has <=8 products — consider hiding them too to match the spec's intent ('category chips only when >8 products').
seed_data_creation: None. Toggled support_widget_show_wall ON via API + UI to verify wall rendering, restored to OFF at the end. Final API check confirms show_wall=false and recent_supporters=[].
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth token: POST /api/user/login returns data.accessToken (JWT ~3.1KB). Company handle for The Dev Store is 'devhub'. Public creator endpoint: /api/pay/creator/<handle>. Creator settings endpoint: GET/PUT /api/user/creator/profile (authed). The support-widget-show-wall toggle's data-testid is on a Radix Switch SPAN; use `el.querySelector('input').checked` to read state — the `data-state` attribute is not exposed. Save button label in DE is 'Änderungen speichern'. Backend Wave 2-3 endpoints all healthy. sessionStorage.mfa_interstitial_seen='1' must be set BEFORE login and after login and before each navigation to skip the 2FA nag interstitial reliably.
